summary: Daughter of Edward McGuire and Mary Jane Gaffney who followed the coal trade from Plymouth, Pa., to Vancouver Island; John's 3rd-great-grand-aunt.
bio:
Cecilia Marcella McGuire was born on 11 November 1864 in Pennsylvania, the daughter of Edward McGuire and Mary Jane Gaffney. At Plymouth, Pa., on 27 December 1886 or 1887, she married Murdock "Murt" Dunn, who was born on 24 December 1862.

The family emigrated to the coalfield of Vancouver Island, British Columbia, and in 1901 were living at South Wellington, Nanaimo. Murdock died that same year. In 1908 Cecilia married again, to Samuel Wilson, at Ladysmith, and she died there on 10 August 1918. Her children were Thomas (1888–1937), Mary (1890–1935), Edward (1892–1909), Ellen (1894–1969), John Thomas (1897–1955) and Murty Vincent (1902–1982). She was John's 3rd-great-grand-aunt.
